title: LIKE A BAD FATHER'S DAY GIFT BOX
text: Wow.  One apparently high-ticket item, like this quarter...a long-sleeve/FLAT-SEAMED fashion t-shirt?!!  Other star items are seen for sale on AMAZON with 3 & 4 star ratings.  This box is full of stuff that USED to be free.  ALL USELESS sample if you're bald.  Eye cream?  Seriously?  Oil-wiping sheets?  That should last 10 minutes.  This is an embarrassment to GQ, who advertises it's magazine for ALL MEN but inside?  There's definitely a target demographic and, I'll give you a hint!  If you don't smoke, then the [literally!] 5 pages of cigarette ads and HENNESSEY ad are not for you.  I paid for a year of boxes and was told they couldn't be cancelled but they would cancel my AUTO-RENEW which I definitely did NOT sign up for.  I see you can get a poorly tie-dyed pair of "favorite" socks if you subscribe NOW!  Tie-dyed white tube socks.  Yeah.  It's THAT bad!
label: negative
